title: Isizwe Esadelela Ukuhleleka Kwemvelo
intro: Esifundeni esinendaba ephindaphindwayo iminyaka eminingi, umphakathi wawuphila ngokuvukela imithetho yobumsulwa obala. Izenzo zabo zazingakaze zibonwe ngaphambili kangangokuthi zikhunjulwa njengesixwayiso kubo bonke abantu. Babengobani laba bantu, futhi bafikelwa yini isiphetho?
clues: Sahlala ezweni eliseduze nendlela abahambi ababevame ukudlula kuyo, kodwa sayenza uhambo lwabo lwaba yingozi.
Senze izenzo zokungahloniphi ezingakaze zenziwe muntu emhlabeni ngaphambili.
Isithunywa esivela phakathi kwethu sasibiza ukuba sishiye izindlela zethu, kodwa samlahla futhi safuna isijeziso uma ekhuluma iqiniso.
Lapho kufika izivakashi ezinhle edolobheni lethu, safuna ukuzihlasela, singazi ukuthi ziyizithunywa zembubhiso.
Saxwayiswa ngesijeziso esibi kakhulu uma singayeki, kodwa sahleka usulu isixwayiso futhi sahlala esonweni sethu.
Imvula yamatshe evela ezulwini yasiwela, izindlu zethu zagumbuqelwa, akushiywanga mkhondo ngaphandle kwesibonakaliso kulabo abacabangayo.

trial.label: Isivivinyo/Umcimbi
options: Kwenziwe ukuziphatha okubi okungakaze kubonwe ngaphambili kanye nemigwaqo evinjiwe
Wakhohliswa kwezohwebo futhi wancisha abantu imali

trial.answer: Kwenziwe ukuziphatha okubi okungakaze kubonwe ngaphambili kanye nemigwaqo evinjiwe

arabic: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient." (29:34)
